assignment: verify proposed dependency-elimination routes against primary sources
tested_scope: Narrowly test whether ordinary ChatGPT Scheduled Tasks are documented as requiring a separately configured OpenAI API key or API billing account for task execution. This slice does not test whether ChatGPT account/plan usage is unlimited, free of plan limits, or sufficient for full Phase-1 closure.

provenance.title: Scheduled tasks in ChatGPT
provenance.source_freshness_observed: OpenAI Help Center page reported Updated: 10 days ago at retrieval

observations: The official page describes Scheduled Tasks as a ChatGPT product feature created and managed from Scheduled or by asking ChatGPT to create a task.
The documented ordinary Scheduled Task creation flow does not instruct the user to configure an OpenAI API key, API project, or API billing account.
The official page explicitly states that model availability and usage limits depend on the task, account plan, and workspace settings, and that active-task limits vary by plan.

The page separately describes event-triggered tasks as using Work plus supported connected apps and their permissions; that separate event-triggered path is outside the narrow ordinary-scheduled-task claim tested here.
inferences: For the narrow ordinary Scheduled Task path tested here, a separate OpenAI API-key/API-billing dependency is not documented as a prerequisite. This supports eliminating that specific external API dependency class from a proposed ChatGPT-native route.

Because the same primary source explicitly retains ChatGPT task/account/workspace usage limits, this evidence cannot establish the broader Phase-1 hard gate of zero finite monthly/trial/paid quota dependency.
unverified_claims: That any particular account has sufficient remaining ChatGPT usage capacity for all Phase-1 work.
That Scheduled Tasks are free of all finite plan or workspace limits.
That all role workloads can be migrated to this path without any other quota-bearing dependency.
That zero incremental cost is established for the full managed pool.

result.verified_claim: Ordinary ChatGPT Scheduled Tasks are documented as a ChatGPT-native feature and the documented setup path does not require a separately configured OpenAI API key or API billing account.
does_not_establish: zero incremental cost for all roles

continuation: Verify the next unresolved dependency-elimination claim from the currently authorized Phase-1 routing set against a primary source. Preserve exact scope and do not generalize this narrow Scheduled-Tasks result to full zero-finite-quota or Phase-1 closure.
